tokens.name: void-900
tokens.usage: Outermost page background behind the hero and the footer. The dark the whole site sits on.

tokens.name: void-800
tokens.usage: Inside of the rounded hero environment and the playground strip. Carries the star field.

tokens.name: void-700
tokens.usage: Raised dark surface: work tiles, playground cards, the pixel-window frame.

tokens.name: void-600
tokens.usage: Hover fill for dark tiles and the resting fill of the MENU pill on dark.

tokens.name: hairline-dark
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and tile borders on void-800 and void-700. Decorative only (1.6:1); never the sole marker of a control.

tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: Warm off-white ground for the full-screen menu, the About band and the light half of Selected Work.

tokens.name: paper-200
tokens.usage: Recessed light surface: image wells, project thumbnails, menu row hover.

tokens.name: hairline-light
tokens.usage: Thin dividers between menu rows and work rows on paper-100. Decorative at 1.5:1 — never use it to outline a control or to carry meaning on its own.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Primary text, menu numerals and headings on paper-100 and paper-200. 16.2:1 on paper-100.

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Secondary and metadata text on paper-100. 6.0:1 on paper-100 — safe at 12px.

tokens.name: star-100
tokens.usage: Primary text on void-900, void-800 and void-700: TWELVE lettering, headings, nav links. 16.5:1 on void-800.

tokens.name: star-400
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions and small labels on void-800 and void-700. 6.9:1 on void-800, 6.5:1 on void-700 — safe at 10px.

tokens.name: star-700
tokens.usage: The resting dot grid of the star field and disabled marks on dark. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: purple-400
tokens.usage: Lit upper edge of the brand dot and the hover tint of purple marks on dark. One step up from purple-500, same hue.

tokens.name: purple-500
tokens.usage: THE Twelve purple, sampled from the dot in the twelve. wordmark. The large hero circle, the period in the wordmark and the 12. stamp on dark, focus rings on dark, link underlines on dark. 9.0:1 on void-800.

tokens.name: purple-600
tokens.usage: One step down from purple-500 for tonal depth: the mid-body of the hero dot's gradient and purple marks that need to sit back. 6.4:1 on void-800.

tokens.name: purple-700
tokens.usage: The deepest tonal step of the same hue: the shaded lower edge of the hero dot and chip borders on void-700. Depth only — never the brand colour itself.

tokens.name: purple-ink
tokens.usage: The same hue darkened for text and rules on paper, where purple-500 reads at only 1.9:1. Menu numerals on hover, the About rule, the 12. period on paper, focus rings on paper. 8.3:1 on paper-100. It is a support tint, not the brand colour.

tokens.name: focus-dark
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element on dark grounds. 9.0:1 on void-800.

tokens.name: focus-light
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element on paper grounds. 8.3:1 on paper-100.

tokens.name: bloom-500

tokens.name: marquee-600

tokens.name: marquee-700

tokens.name: marquee-100
